note: Curated hub entries. scripts/generate_hub.py rebuilds index.html from this file, checks every link live, drops dead ones, and auto-adds any public ysrao repo not listed here. Edit titles/descriptions here, never in index.html directly.

cards.description: Ray-traced coverage and capacity for one tower across five bands (0.7 / 2.5 / 3.6 / 7.125 / 28 GHz), four Rancho Bernardo sites, downlink + uplink.
cards.title: twin5GNR — single-tower 5G NR twin

cards.description: 3 towers × 3 sectors at 3.6 GHz (v7, Sionna ray-traced, with vegetation) and 16 small cells × 3 sectors at 28 GHz (v8), on the San Francisco 1 km² Vexcel mesh. CQI handoff trigger.

cards.description: Per-tower Current vs Change planner at street and rooftop level: what an upgrade does to rates and coverage before you spend on it.

cards.description: Macro / pico / femto multi-tier twin console used for the slice-dimensioning studies.
